cacheScopeExplanation.message: Bounded keeps up to 100 recently used lyric entries. Translation and transliteration share a separate derived-results library, also capped at 100 recently used entries in total. Each library evicts its least recently used entries. When a cached source is reused, its SHA-256 is checked; a changed source refreshes the result, and a failed check falls back to the existing cached copy. With caching off, results are not stored, while source indexes may still refresh when online. Clearing caches removes cached results only: local TTML, lyric offsets, source preferences and fonts are kept. Source indexes are managed separately and may be refreshed during verification. The sizes above do not include source indexes.
